model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect sizes of six different language models—mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—across nine linguistic categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The horizontal axis lists these linguistic categories in alphabetical order, while the vertical axis, labeled “effect,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each linguistic category is represented by a group of six colored bars, corresponding to the models as indicated in the legend: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, light pink for mBERT-B₂, and dark red for XLM-B₂. Error bars extend vertically from each bar, indicating variability or uncertainty in the measurements.
